contexts.statement: OpenAI Math Audit #054: Irrational cubic fourfolds with Hodge-theoretic and categorical K3 associations.
Audit the literal operator theorem gw:blowup and its two relative reconstruction lemmas in the fixed classical integral blowup basis.

definitions.M: a rationally connected smooth projective complex fourfold
definitions.pi:Y->M: blowup of a connected smooth center Z of codimension at least two
definitions.T: the torsion-free integral cup-orthogonal complement of rational Hodge classes, rationalized for operators
definitions.allowed_invariant: connected genus-zero numerical-class Gromov-Witten invariant with two distinctly labelled transcendental variable slots, arbitrary nonnegative ordinary descendants, and other rational diagonal-Hodge insertions

contexts.statement: Genus-zero blowup reconstruction for smooth projective complex fourfolds with H^{2,0}=H^{4,0}=0; rational connectedness is not assumed.

definitions.T_X: the torsion-free integral cup-orthogonal complement of rational (2,2) classes in H^4(X), rationalized when taking operators
definitions.G_X: unital rational algebra of connected genus-zero two-T_X descendant operators with all other ordinary insertions rational diagonal Hodge classes and with two distinct formal variable labels
definitions.blowup: blowup in a connected smooth center of codimension at least two

claims.natural_statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 054 (Irrational cubic fourfolds with Hodge-theoretic and categorical K3 associations.; papers: Irrational cubic fourfolds with geometric K3 categories; Lean status: UNFORMALIZED (No Lean proof in openai/math)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

Theorem gw:blowup: in the classical embeddings, (T_Y,q_Y)=(T_M,q_M) orthogonal-sum (T_Z(-1),-q_Z) over Z and G_Y=G_M direct-product Q id_T_Z for a surface center; the new factor is omitted when T_Z=0. For a curve or point center T_Y=T_M integrally and G_Y=G_M. Every allowed invariant preserves these summands, is scalar on the new summand, and its old block lies in precisely G_M.
The classical blowup maps pi^* and j_*p^* give the integral orthogonal transcendental decomposition T_Y=T_M plus T_Z(-1), with exceptional cup form -q_Z.

Lemma gw:local: on the indicated projective bundles over Z, connected genus-zero absolute or infinity-relative tensors on two tautological copies of T_Z are scalar q_Z and vanish for nonzero projected curve class, including ordinary descendants and expanded targets.

Lemma gw:relative: relative tensors on (Y,D), with original ordinary classes pulled back from M and arbitrary original ordinary descendants, satisfy the T_M,T_M in G_M; W,W scalar; mixed zero table, after translating (k,xi^b p^*delta) to tau_{r(k-1)+b}(i_*delta).

Lemma gw:divisor: with arbitrary ordinary diagonal insertions and ordinary descendants, relative tensors on (Y,D) have old-old block in pr_M G_Y, exceptional-exceptional block scalar, and zero mixed block, allowing variables at ordinary or boundary markings as stated in the manuscript.

Equation gw:exceptional-line: for an exceptional line e and u,v in T_Z,Q, the two-point invariant <j_*p^*u,j_*p^*v>_{0,e} is integral_Z uv and all old-variable entries vanish; its operator is minus the new-summand projector.

Lemma gw:blocks: in every smooth weak factorization from P^4, the transcendental lattices are integral orthogonal sums of whole shifted surface transcendental lattices and each nonzero blowdown removes exactly one such whole summand.

Theorem thm:main: for every sufficiently large admissible d, a very general cubic fourfold in C_d is irrational and its Kuznetsov component is equivalent to the ordinary derived category of a projective K3 surface.
The uniform marked Sarkisov diagrams satisfy the bounds asserted in Theorem bd:diagrams of the staged manuscript.
The intrinsic correction and subfield argument imply c_u(f)=0 as asserted in Theorem sf:vanishing of the staged manuscript.

import Mathlib

namespace BlowupReconstruction

def positiveCount : List Nat → Nat
  | [] => 0
  | a :: xs => (if a = 0 then 0 else 1) + positiveCount xs

theorem positiveCount_le_sum (xs : List Nat) :
    positiveCount xs ≤ xs.sum := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp [positiveCount]
  | cons a xs ih =>
      simp only [positiveCount, List.sum_cons]
      split_ifs <;> omega

theorem positiveCount_lt_of_merge (xs : List Nat)
    (h : ∃ a ∈ xs, 1 < a) : positiveCount xs < xs.sum := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => simpa using h
  | cons a xs ih =>
      rcases h with ⟨b, hb, hbig⟩
      simp only [List.mem_cons] at hb
      rcases hb with rfl | hb
      · have hrest := positiveCount_le_sum xs
        have ha : a ≠ 0 := by omega
        simp only [positiveCount, if_neg ha, List.sum_cons]
        omega
      · have hrest := ih ⟨b, hb, hbig⟩
        simp only [positiveCount, List.sum_cons]
        split_ifs <;> omega

theorem positiveCount_rigidity (xs : List Nat)
    (h : positiveCount xs = xs.sum) : ∀ a ∈ xs, a ≤ 1 := by
  intro a ha
  by_contra hbig
  have hlt := positiveCount_lt_of_merge xs ⟨a, ha, by omega⟩
  omega

theorem length_le_sum_of_positive (xs : List Nat)
    (h : ∀ a ∈ xs, 0 < a) : xs.length ≤ xs.sum := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a xs ih =>
      have ha := h a (by simp)
      have ht : ∀ b ∈ xs, 0 < b := by
        intro b hb
        exact h b (by simp [hb])
      have hl := ih ht
      simp only [List.length_cons, List.sum_cons]
      omega

theorem restricted_contact (r k kp b : Nat)
    (hr : 0 < r) (hb : b < r)
    (hc : 0 ≤ (r : Int) * k - (r : Int) * kp + b) : kp ≤ k := by
  by_contra h
  have hkp : (k : Int) + 1 ≤ kp := by omega
  have hr' : (0 : Int) < r := by omega
  have hb' : (b : Int) < r := by omega
  nlinarith

theorem restricted_empty_tail (r kp : Nat) (hr : 2 ≤ r) (hk : 0 < kp) :
    1 - (r : Int) * kp < 0 := by
  have hr' : (2 : Int) ≤ r := by omega
  have hk' : (1 : Int) ≤ kp := by omega
  nlinarith

def divisorCodim (tail : List Nat × Nat) : Int :=
  (tail.1.sum : Int) - tail.1.length - tail.2 + 1

def inputContact (tails : List (List Nat × Nat)) : Nat :=
  (tails.map fun tail => tail.1.sum).sum

def inputLength (tails : List (List Nat × Nat)) : Nat :=
  (tails.map fun tail => tail.1.length).sum

def outputContact (tails : List (List Nat × Nat)) : Nat :=
  (tails.map fun tail => tail.2).sum

theorem divisor_balance (tails : List (List Nat × Nat)) :
    (tails.map divisorCodim).sum =
      (inputContact tails : Int) - inputLength tails -
        outputContact tails + tails.length := by
  induction tails with
  | nil => simp [inputContact, inputLength, outputContact]
  | cons tail tails ih =>
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, List.length_cons]
      simp only [inputContact, inputLength, outputContact, List.map_cons,
        List.sum_cons] at *
      push_cast
      unfold divisorCodim
      omega

theorem divisor_length_order (tails : List (List Nat × Nat))
    (hcontact : inputContact tails = outputContact tails)
    (hnonneg : 0 ≤ (tails.map divisorCodim).sum) :
    inputLength tails ≤ tails.length := by
  have hbalance := divisor_balance tails
  omega

theorem empty_divisor_tail (kp : Nat) (hk : 0 < kp)
    (hc : 0 ≤ divisorCodim ([], kp)) : kp = 1 := by
  simp [divisorCodim] at hc
  omega

def divisorMeasure (K L p : Nat) : Nat := (K - L) * (K + 1) + p

theorem divisor_measure_lt (K L t p pp : Nat)
    (hL : L ≤ K) (ht : t ≤ K) (hpp : pp ≤ t)
    (h : L < t ∨ (L = t ∧ pp < p)) :
    divisorMeasure K t pp < divisorMeasure K L p := by
  rcases h with hlength | ⟨rfl, hcount⟩
  · have hstep : K - t + 1 ≤ K - L := by omega
    have hmul := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (K + 1) hstep
    unfold divisorMeasure
    nlinarith
  · exact Nat.add_lt_add_left hcount _

def fibreCoefficient (r k j : Nat) : Rat :=
  1 / ((k : Rat) ^ (r - j) * (Nat.factorial (k - 1) : Rat) ^ r)

theorem fibreCoefficient_pos (r k j : Nat) (hk : 0 < k) :
    0 < fibreCoefficient r k j := by
  have hk' : (0 : Rat) < k := by exact_mod_cast hk
  have hf : (0 : Rat) < Nat.factorial (k - 1) := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_pos (k - 1)
  unfold fibreCoefficient
  positivity

theorem labelled_tail_coefficient_pos (r k j m : Nat) (hk : 0 < k) :
    0 < (k : Rat) ^ (m + 1) * fibreCoefficient r k j := by
  have hk' : (0 : Rat) < k := by exact_mod_cast hk
  exact mul_pos (pow_pos hk' _) (fibreCoefficient_pos r k j hk)

theorem tensor_recover {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module Rat V]
    (S : Submodule Rat V) (A B R : V) (c : Rat) (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (h : A = c • B + R) (hA : A ∈ S) (hR : R ∈ S) : B ∈ S := by
  have hscaled : c • B ∈ S := by
    simpa [h] using S.sub_mem hA hR
  have hdivided := S.smul_mem c⁻¹ hscaled
  simpa [smul_smul, hc] using hdivided

end BlowupReconstruction

claims.natural_statement: The unbounded integer tail-codimension constraints force the restricted contact order, the finite reversed-length divisor order, and strict loss or singleton rigidity of the positive-weight count; a nonzero vector-independent rational leading coefficient reconstructs membership in a rational tensor submodule from an allowed absolute tensor and allowed remainder.
claims.formal_statement:
import Mathlib

namespace BlowupReconstruction

def positiveCount : List Nat → Nat
  | [] => 0
  | a :: xs => (if a = 0 then 0 else 1) + positiveCount xs

theorem positiveCount_le_sum (xs : List Nat) :
    positiveCount xs ≤ xs.sum := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp [positiveCount]
  | cons a xs ih =>
      simp only [positiveCount, List.sum_cons]
      split_ifs <;> omega

theorem positiveCount_lt_of_merge (xs : List Nat)
    (h : ∃ a ∈ xs, 1 < a) : positiveCount xs < xs.sum := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp at h
  | cons a xs ih =>
      rcases h with ⟨b, hb, hbig⟩
      simp only [List.mem_cons] at hb
      rcases hb with hba | hb
      · subst b
        have hrest := positiveCount_le_sum xs
        have ha : a ≠ 0 := by omega
        simp only [positiveCount, if_neg ha, List.sum_cons]
        omega
      · have hrest := ih ⟨b, hb, hbig⟩
        simp only [positiveCount, List.sum_cons]
        split_ifs <;> omega

theorem positiveCount_rigidity (xs : List Nat)
    (h : positiveCount xs = xs.sum) : ∀ a ∈ xs, a ≤ 1 := by
  intro a ha
  by_contra hbig
  have hlt := positiveCount_lt_of_merge xs ⟨a, ha, by omega⟩
  omega

theorem length_le_sum_of_positive (xs : List Nat)
    (h : ∀ a ∈ xs, 0 < a) : xs.length ≤ xs.sum := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a xs ih =>
      have ha := h a (by simp)
      have ht : ∀ b ∈ xs, 0 < b := by
        intro b hb
        exact h b (by simp [hb])
      have hl := ih ht
      simp only [List.length_cons, List.sum_cons]
      omega

theorem restricted_contact (r k kp b : Nat)
    (hr : 0 < r) (hb : b < r)
    (hc : 0 ≤ (r : Int) * k - (r : Int) * kp + b) : kp ≤ k := by
  by_contra h
  have hkp : (k : Int) + 1 ≤ kp := by omega
  have hr' : (0 : Int) < r := by omega
  have hb' : (b : Int) < r := by omega
  nlinarith

theorem restricted_empty_tail (r kp : Nat) (hr : 2 ≤ r) (hk : 0 < kp) :
    1 - (r : Int) * kp < 0 := by
  have hr' : (2 : Int) ≤ r := by omega
  have hk' : (1 : Int) ≤ kp := by omega
  nlinarith

def divisorCodim (tail : List Nat × Nat) : Int :=
  (tail.1.sum : Int) - tail.1.length - tail.2 + 1

def inputContact (tails : List (List Nat × Nat)) : Nat :=
  (tails.map fun tail => tail.1.sum).sum

def inputLength (tails : List (List Nat × Nat)) : Nat :=
  (tails.map fun tail => tail.1.length).sum

def outputContact (tails : List (List Nat × Nat)) : Nat :=
  (tails.map fun tail => tail.2).sum

theorem divisor_balance (tails : List (List Nat × Nat)) :
    (tails.map divisorCodim).sum =
      (inputContact tails : Int) - inputLength tails -
        outputContact tails + tails.length := by
  induction tails with
  | nil => simp [inputContact, inputLength, outputContact]
  | cons tail tails ih =>
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, List.length_cons]
      simp only [inputContact, inputLength, outputContact, List.map_cons,
        List.sum_cons] at *
      simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
      unfold divisorCodim at *
      omega

theorem divisor_length_order (tails : List (List Nat × Nat))
    (hcontact : inputContact tails = outputContact tails)
    (hnonneg : 0 ≤ (tails.map divisorCodim).sum) :
    inputLength tails ≤ tails.length := by
  have hbalance := divisor_balance tails
  omega

theorem empty_divisor_tail (kp : Nat) (hk : 0 < kp)
    (hc : 0 ≤ divisorCodim ([], kp)) : kp = 1 := by
  simp [divisorCodim] at hc
  omega

def divisorMeasure (K L p : Nat) : Nat := (K - L) * (K + 1) + p

theorem divisor_measure_lt (K L t p pp : Nat)
    (hL : L ≤ K) (ht : t ≤ K) (hpp : pp ≤ t)
    (h : L < t ∨ (L = t ∧ pp < p)) :
    divisorMeasure K t pp < divisorMeasure K L p := by
  rcases h with hlength | ⟨rfl, hcount⟩
  · have hstep : K - t + 1 ≤ K - L := by omega
    have hmul := Nat.mul_le_mul_right (K + 1) hstep
    unfold divisorMeasure
    nlinarith
  · exact Nat.add_lt_add_left hcount _

def fibreCoefficient (r k j : Nat) : Rat :=
  1 / ((k : Rat) ^ (r - j) * (Nat.factorial (k - 1) : Rat) ^ r)

theorem fibreCoefficient_pos (r k j : Nat) (hk : 0 < k) :
    0 < fibreCoefficient r k j := by
  have hk' : (0 : Rat) < k := by exact_mod_cast hk
  have hf : (0 : Rat) < Nat.factorial (k - 1) := by
    exact_mod_cast Nat.factorial_pos (k - 1)
  unfold fibreCoefficient
  positivity

theorem labelled_tail_coefficient_pos (r k j m : Nat) (hk : 0 < k) :
    0 < (k : Rat) ^ (m + 1) * fibreCoefficient r k j := by
  have hk' : (0 : Rat) < k := by exact_mod_cast hk
  exact mul_pos (pow_pos hk' _) (fibreCoefficient_pos r k j hk)

theorem tensor_recover {V : Type*} [AddCommGroup V] [Module Rat V]
    (S : Submodule Rat V) (A B R : V) (c : Rat) (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (h : A = c • B + R) (hA : A ∈ S) (hR : R ∈ S) : B ∈ S := by
  have hscaled : c • B ∈ S := by
    simpa [h] using S.sub_mem hA hR
  have hdivided := S.smul_mem c⁻¹ hscaled
  simpa [smul_smul, hc] using hdivided

end BlowupReconstruction

claims.natural_statement: For the allowed blowup, the two ambient Hodge vanishings give the classical integral orthogonal transcendental splitting, scalar local W-W tensors vanishing in positive projected degree, and the degree-one exceptional operator equal to minus its projector.

With arbitrary original ordinary descendants and ordinary classes pulled back from M, the codimension-r relative reconstruction on (Y,D) has old-old tensors in G_M, W-W tensors in Q q_Z, and zero mixed tensors; relative weights translate to tau_{r(k-1)+b}(i_*delta) and the vector-independent leading coefficient is nonzero.

After the inclusion G_Y subset G_M plus Q id_W is established, divisor reconstruction with arbitrary ordinary diagonal insertions and descendants preserves the separated old-old, W-W and mixed rows, has MP leading coefficient K^q times product 1/(k_j-1)! in the weighted-partition normalization, and recovers exactly G_M on the old summand.

claims.natural_statement: Theorem gw:blowup: in the classical embeddings, (T_Y,q_Y)=(T_M,q_M) orthogonal-sum (T_Z(-1),-q_Z) over Z and G_Y=G_M direct-product Q id_T_Z for a surface center; the new factor is omitted when T_Z=0. For a curve or point center T_Y=T_M integrally and G_Y=G_M. Every allowed invariant preserves these summands, is scalar on the new summand, and its old block lies in precisely G_M.

external_assumptions.statement: For a smooth projective rationally connected complex variety, H^0(X,(Omega_X^1)^{tensor m})=0 for every m>=1. In characteristic zero exterior powers embed into the corresponding tensor powers, so in particular h^{2,0}=h^{4,0}=0.
external_assumptions.source: Araujo-Kollar, Rational Curves on Varieties, exact arXiv v2 (2002)
